label: Rainy café
prompt: Capture a beautifully detailed cozy cafe in the rain, with warm amber lighting, dark walnut floor, brick and plaster cafe walls, large rain-streaked windows and rich coherent pixel art. EXACTLY THREE sound objects: rain pattering against a glass window (bed), a working espresso machine with steady steam hiss (bed), and a porcelain cup and saucer clinking once (event, random gaps 12-25 seconds). Give every sound its recognizable animated physical source sprite. No speech or music. Only these three objects; no decorative freestanding objects. Preserve the normal full room dimensions. Use restrained detailed material shading, readable silhouettes and a cohesive palette.
reviewNotes: Three curated sources, two beds plus one quieter distant random event. Initial source placements tuned for the demo.
